page: Amazon Web Services r8in.32xlarge is an eighth-generation memory-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. The platform is built on an Intel x86_64 architecture running at 3.9 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs derived from 64 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory capacity is provisioned at 1024 GB, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio to accommodate large-footprint datasets requiring fast random access.

The configuration integrates a 200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating sustained high-speed data transfers across cluster environments. No local storage or discrete graphics accelerators are provisioned on the host, meaning all storage persistence relies on external network-attached volumes. Amazon Web Services r8in.32xlarge is primarily suited for large in-memory databases, distributed memory caches, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise resource planning software.
description: Amazon Web Services r8in.32xlarge is an eighth-generation memory-optimized instance designed for large memory-bound workloads. Based on the Intel x86_64 architecture and running under the Nitro hypervisor, the platform provides 128 dedicated virtual CPUs across 64 physical cores at a 3.9 GHz clock rate. System memory is scaled to 1024 GB, offering an 8:1 gigabyte-to-vCPU allocation ratio. Network performance is anchored by a 200 Gbps baseline connection to facilitate high-throughput node synchronization and remote storage traffic. The instance includes no onboard local storage drives and no discrete GPUs, necessitating remote volumes for filesystem persistence. With its high memory density and extensive network capacity, the instance is targeted at enterprise database systems, distributed memory caches, and memory-intensive analytics.
